criteria.reason: Final approve/reject authority explicitly reserved to human caseworker; AI limited to extraction, flagging, drafting.
Detailed multi-phase project plan with stakeholders, requirements, pilot, rollout, governance for the municipality.
States Swiss regulations mandate human oversight of automated decisions and appeal to human review body.
Requires explainable AI outputs, appeal rights in decision letter, and full audit trail.

summary: Delivers a thorough AI-assisted project plan keeping final Sozialhilfe decisions with human caseworkers, citing human-review and appeal rights under Swiss law.
